final_response: Replied to the client asking for specifics: affected endpoint(s), when the issue started, observed timeout duration, and any error messages. This is linked to ticket T-api-CT_AB_1_001.

args.body:
Hi,

Thank you for reaching out about the API timeout problem. To help us investigate, could you please provide a bit more detail?

- Which API endpoint(s) are timing out?
- When did the issue first occur, and is it happening consistently or intermittently?
- What timeout duration are you observing?
- Are there any error messages or codes returned?

We have an open ticket (T-api-CT_AB_1_001) tracking this and want to make sure we have all the information needed to resolve it quickly.

Thanks!
